request: Add a connecting hole of 1.7 millimetre diameter and apply 0.1 millimetre grooves to increase grip and prevent slipping.

actions.operation: Create a hole (cut) intended to be connecting

parameters.end_condition: Through all (connect underside pocket to exterior/top surface)

actions.target: Create a small connecting/vent/drain hole that opens from the underside pocket out to the exterior of the bracket (connects SEC05 pocket cavity to outside), placed centrally to avoid weakening mounting lobes and the clevis pin interface.
actions.relational_constraint: Hole should be connecting by intersecting the underside pocket volume (SEC05) and exiting to an exterior surface (SEC03 top deck region), while staying clear of the 4 mounting holes and clevis lug pin-hole bores.
actions.unresolved_reference: If the connecting hole is instead intended as a fastener hole (tapping/countersink) or must connect two specific named features; this plan assumes a vent/drain/tie-through style connecting hole that links the underside pocket to the outside.
steps: Select SEC05 pocket floor plane (face_code 0045, Brep FACE 103) as the sketch plane; set sketch normal aligned with the pocket floor normal (same normal as global bottom datum).

In the sketch, project/convert the pocket floor boundary edges to capture the pocket-floor perimeter; construct two diagonal construction lines between opposite pocket-floor corner points and place a sketch point at their intersection (centroid of face 0045).
Create a circle centered at the centroid point with diameter = 1.7 mm (fully constrain to the centroid).

Perform an Extruded Cut / Hole feature normal to the sketch plane with end condition = Through All (upward, away from the pocket) so the cut passes through the bracket body and exits the exterior top surface in the central body region (expected to break out on the SEC03 top deck facet, face_code 0027, Brep FACE 99).

Validate connectivity: confirm the resulting cylindrical face of the new hole opens into the underside pocket (SEC05) and also opens to the exterior (SEC03), and confirm minimum edge distances to nearby ribs/walls remain acceptable.

actions.operation: Add grooves (surface texturing / patterned cuts or embossed features)

parameters.interpretation: 0.1 mm groove depth and 0.1 mm groove width
parameters.groove_pattern: concentric annular grooves around each of the 4 mounting holes on the bottom contact face
parameters.quantity_per_hole: 3 rings per hole (parametric; can be adjusted)

actions.target: Bottom mounting/contact interface surface so the bracket has anti-slip texture against the mating structure under bolt preload (adds friction where clamping occurs).
actions.relational_constraint: Grooves applied on the bottom base plane around the four mounting holes (SEC01+SEC02 pattern) to increase friction and reduce slip; keep grooves on planar contact land only (do not place on fillets/rounds).
actions.unresolved_reference: Exact desired groove coverage and density (number of rings/pitch) and whether grooves must avoid specific sealing/contact requirements; this plan assumes shallow engraved grooves on the planar bottom contact face only.
steps: Select SEC03 bottom base plane (face_code 0024, Brep FACE 77) as the sketch plane (this is the primary datum/contact face visible as the outer frame around the underside pocket).

Project/convert the four mounting hole circular edges that intersect the bottom face to capture their centers; use the cylindrical small-bore references for the four holes to ensure correct center association: SEC01 L1 small bore (face_code 0004, Brep FACE 49), SEC01 L2 small bore (face_code 0008, Brep FACE 50), SEC02 R1 small bore (face_code 0016, Brep FACE 51), SEC02 R2 small bore (face_code 0020, Brep FACE 52).

For each mounting hole center, sketch 3 concentric annular groove profiles as thin rings: create pairs of concentric circles to define each ring’s inner/outer diameter such that groove width = 0.1 mm; set the first ring inner radius = (mounting hole radius + 0.3 mm) and set radial spacing between rings = 0.2 mm (both parametric).
Create the groove regions by trimming/defining closed ring profiles for all 4 holes (total 12 ring profiles if using 3 rings per hole).

Perform an Extruded Cut normal to face 0024 with depth = 0.1 mm into the part (engraved grooves). Ensure the cut only affects the bottom planar land and does not unintentionally break into the underside pocket floor (face_code 0045) or into the mounting hole bores beyond the intended ring geometry.

If needed, apply a sketch-driven pattern constraint: mirror the groove sketch across the longitudinal symmetry plane (Z mid-plane intent noted in model) so left/right and pos-Z/neg-Z groove placements remain symmetric with the 4-hole mounting pattern.
